name: Price Alert
description: Checks a portfolio CSV against today's prices and raises an alert only when a position moved at least threshold_pct percent, up or down. Fully deterministic (no AI text, so an alert can never contradict the numbers). Every check is logged; an alert file is written only when something qualifies. Read-only: no trading and no advice. Inputs: portfolio_path, source (yahoo or simulated), threshold_pct (e.g. 3), log_path, alert_path.
